firm_data.firm_description: Feldman Kramer Monaco has been protecting client interests and achieving client goals for more than 35 years.
notable_facts: The firm services approximately 250,000 families through legal plans.
Warren Feldman has lectured on behalf of the American Bar Association throughout the world regarding access to justice for the middleclass.

email.subject: AI for Feldman Kramer Monaco, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi William,

Serving 250,000 families through legal plans means your firm has mastered something most practices struggle with: delivering quality at scale. That efficiency matters now more than ever.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by Hauppauge to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete without compromising what makes you different.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
